description: Native HTML autoFocus on a modal's first input silently breaks focus restore: it fires during React's synchronous DOM commit, BEFORE any useEffect runs, so it races ahead of the a11y hook's mount-time capture of the previously-focused element. status: RESOLVED in the five known cases; any FUTURE modal that reaches for autoFocus will reintroduce it, and no guard currently prevents that
